coverage_note: Short lesson: ends ~30:00 when Medi takes a work call; 30:17-33:06 background only. 09:27-19:13 and 21:00-22:20 mostly English meta talk (plurals of awal/aa5er, non-human plurals treated as feminine, -ish negation intro); his questions there (kabar/kabira, buyud/bayda, sayarat bimshu/btimshi, biddesh) not scored. Echo: 11:57 'الدروس السبع' = الدروس الصعبة. 01:27 'كمان، 20' unclear (maybe kaman marra). 03:21 'وذباين' read as و زباين. 05:57 'ا weights دائما' engine garble. 08:00 'أول' before the temperature unclear. 04:22-04:30 الآخر/أخيرة/الأخير chain read as self-searching; filed only the 04:09 number fix and 04:37 gender fix. 07:40 الجو شمس not flagged (sheet: it's sunny | El-denia shames). 20:33 behkesh->behkish self-fixed before her long-vowel note (F2, not scored). 28:46-29:24 t-cluster pronunciation in inbasa6tish = S4. No echo-candidates file for 11-05.

rows.amal_said: No. You're a key. You can't open.
rows.why: He said maftoo7 (open) for mirtaa7 (relaxed); Amal said no ('you can't open') and he then found مرتاح (sheet: comfortable / relaxed | Mertaa7 | مرتاح).

rows.medi_said: شغلت بيتي. من بيتي؟ لا، شغلت بيتي.
rows.why: He dropped min ('worked my house'), rejected his own من بيتي, and Amal restored it: صح، من بيتي; he repeated من بيتي.
rows.english: Yesterday I worked from my house.

rows.medi_said: شغلت بيتي. من بيتي؟ لا، شغلت بيتي.
rows.why: شغّلت is the make-X form (I ran / turned on / employed); 'I worked' is اشتغلت (sheet: work | Eshte8el); Amal let it pass (could be the engine dropping the ish-).
Talking about this morning (already over, 'I had three meetings') needs kaan for 'was'; Amal let it pass. My reading.
He put el- on aa5er before the noun ('the end of'); Amal asked 'Did you add in [el]?' and he dropped it: آخر اجتماعاتي.
He used the plural اجتماعات for the single last meeting; Amal: 'It's one. اجتماع.' and he answered 'You're right'.
Feminine adjective on masculine اجتماع; Amal: 'No, اجتماع is masculine. You don't need a t.' and he said اجتماعي الأخير at 04:50.
Clock time takes el- + the feminine number; Amal recast الوحدة and he repeated الـ واحدة.

rows.amal_said: Mm. No. ... When do we take out the أ in numbers؟
rows.why: A date number with no counted noun keeps its -a (khamse); Amal said No, he fixed to خمسة, and she asked when we drop it (only before a counted noun).

rows.medi_said: الساعة، uh, تسعة عشر إلا اثني عشر.
rows.why: The hour comes first and the minutes after illa (12 minus 19 min); he reversed them ('19 minus 12'); Amal moved on to the weather. My reading.
Giving the temperature as a bare number; Amal said 'No. مش خمس.' right after drilling when the -a drops - a number with no noun keeps it; he did not fix it (خمس و، ستة عشر).

rows.medi_said: uh, لازم-- uh, بنحتاج، uh, جعل الكلمة أخير.
rows.why: جعل is MSA (made/put, past); spoken 'put' is 7ott (sheet: put | 7ott | حط); Amal let it pass and only reacted to the meaning.
rows.english: We need to put the word last.

rows.medi_said: uh, لازم-- uh, بنحتاج، uh, جعل الكلمة أخير.
rows.why: After a need-word the next verb is a bare present (n7ott); he used a past/masdar form; Amal let it pass.
rows.english: We need to put the word last.

rows.why: a5eer is the adjective 'last'; 'at the end' (position) is bil-aa5er; Amal let it pass. My reading.
rows.english: Put the word at the end.

rows.why: Engine wrote السبع = الصعبة: he repeated her sentence with el- on the adjective (a phrase 'the hard lessons', not 'the lessons are hard'); Amal: No. صعبة.
In the -ish drill he did not know her بلعب and asked what it means, then got 'balabit'; a didn't-know.

rows.amal_said: That's I don't miss. I don't complain.
rows.why: For 'I don't complain' he said the 'miss' verb (bashta2ish); Amal: 'That's I don't miss. I don't complain.' (sheet: i complain | Ana bashki | أنا بشكي).

rows.amal_said: مهم. Where's the t؟ You keep the t.
rows.why: A negative command uses the YOU-form (t-); he dropped the t; Amal: 'Where's the t? You keep the t.'
He used the zi33ij (annoy someone) shape for 'get annoyed'; Amal gave بنزعج and he said 'There's an N.'

rows.medi_said: but, uh, if I do enzaigish, there's no ma, right? Enzaigish.
rows.why: Right after her t- fix he dropped the you-form t again (inzi3jish); Amal: 'it doesn't work. تنزعجش.' - its own slip (GR-32).
In the -ish negation drill he left off -ish; Amal: 'No. Where's your ish?'
rows.proposed_rule: A negative verb (also a negative command) can take -ish on the end, with or without ma: ma tinbis6ish, bi7kiish, tinzi3jish.

rows.medi_said: Oh yeah, fio. Matenbisti fio ziyad.

rows.proposed_rule: A negative verb (also a negative command) can take -ish on the end, with or without ma: ma tinbis6ish, bi7kiish, tinzi3jish.
